issues: The draft ignores severe evidence conflicts. The evidence array claims the account has no prior fraud cases, but the Precedent specialist cites an extensive history of confirmed fraud cases (CC-1066, CC-1673, etc.) on this exact card.

There is a conflict regarding the transaction pattern: the Identity specialist claims it is consistent, while the Transaction specialist identifies extreme geographical dispersion and impossible travel across multiple regions within 72 hours.
Because the evidence conflicts, Policy R8 requires the action ESCALATE_TO_ANALYST. The draft incorrectly applies Section 6 to close the case as legitimate.
events.what_would_change_verdict: Acknowledge the conflicting evidence regarding prior fraud and impossible travel, adjust the fraud probability to reflect the uncertainty, and apply Policy R8 to escalate the case to an analyst.
